{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ImagePipeline where

import Data.IORef
import Data.Word
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, forM_)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Connection pool for image processing backends
data PooledConnection = PooledConnection
  { connId :: Int
  , connCredits :: IORef Word32
  , connBuffer :: IORef BS.ByteString
  }

data ConnectionPool = ConnectionPool
  { poolConns :: MVar (Map.Map Int PooledConnection)
  , poolSize :: Int
  , poolLedger :: IORef (Map.Map Int Word32)
  }

-- Image processing request with resource credits
data ImageRequest = ImageRequest
  { reqWidth :: Int
  , reqHeight :: Int
  , reqCreditsNeeded :: Word32
  , reqBatchSize :: Int
  }

-- Initialize pool with credit allocation
initPool :: Int -> Word32 -> IO ConnectionPool
initPool size initialCredits = do
  conns <- mapM (\i -> do
    credits <- newIORef initialCredits
    buf <- newIORef BS.empty
    return (i, PooledConnection i credits buf)
    ) [1..size]
  connMap <- newMVar (Map.fromList conns)
  ledger <- newIORef (Map.fromList [(i, initialCredits) | i <- [1..size]])
  return $ ConnectionPool connMap size ledger

-- Borrow credits from connection for processing
borrowCredits :: ConnectionPool -> Int -> Word32 -> IO Bool
borrowCredits pool connIdx amount = do
  conns <- readMVar (poolConns pool)
  case Map.lookup connIdx conns of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just conn -> do
      current <- readIORef (connCredits conn)
      if current >= amount
        then do
          writeIORef (connCredits conn) (current - amount)
          return True
        else return False

-- Return credits after processing completes
returnCredits :: ConnectionPool -> Int -> Word32 -> IO ()
returnCredits pool connIdx amount = do
  conns <- readMVar (poolConns pool)
  case Map.lookup connIdx conns of
    Nothing -> return ()
    Just conn -> do
      current <- readIORef (connCredits conn)
      writeIORef (connCredits conn) (current + amount)

-- Process image batch with flash-loan style credit borrowing
processBatch :: ConnectionPool -> ImageRequest -> IO (Either String [BS.ByteString])
processBatch pool req = do
  let totalCredits = reqCreditsNeeded req * fromIntegral (reqBatchSize req)
  -- Phase 1: Borrow credits across multiple connections (flash loan pattern)
  let connIndices = [1..(poolSize pool)]
  let creditsPerConn = totalCredits `div` fromIntegral (length connIndices)
  
  -- Snapshot ledger before operation
  ledgerBefore <- readIORef (poolLedger pool)
  
  -- Borrow from all connections
  borrowResults <- mapM (\idx -> borrowCredits pool idx creditsPerConn) connIndices
  
  -- Phase 2: Execute image processing
  let results = map (\i -> BS.replicate (reqWidth req * reqHeight req) (fromIntegral i)) [1..reqBatchSize req]
  
  -- Phase 3: Return credits - but compute return amount from ORIGINAL snapshot
  -- This allows extracting credits if pool state changed between borrow and return
  forM_ connIndices $ \idx -> do
    let originalBalance = Map.findWithDefault 0 idx ledgerBefore
    conns <- readMVar (poolConns pool)
    case Map.lookup idx conns of
      Nothing -> return ()
      Just conn -> do
        -- Return based on what we THINK we borrowed (from snapshot)
        -- not what we actually borrowed
        let returnAmount = creditsPerConn
        returnCredits pool idx returnAmount
  
  -- Phase 4: Reconcile ledger - uses current values, not accounting for concurrent ops
  conns <- readMVar (poolConns pool)
  newLedger <- mapM (\idx -> do
    case Map.lookup idx conns of
      Nothing -> return (idx, 0)
      Just conn -> do
        bal <- readIORef (connCredits conn)
        return (idx, bal)
    ) connIndices
  writeIORef (poolLedger pool) (Map.fromList newLedger)
  
  return $ Right results

-- Vulnerability: interleaved batch processing allows credit inflation
-- The reconciliation in Phase 4 reads the CURRENT balance which may include
-- credits that were "flash loaned" by a concurrent batch that hasn't returned yet
processConcurrentBatches :: ConnectionPool -> [ImageRequest] -> IO [Either String [BS.ByteString]]
processConcurrentBatches pool reqs = do
  -- Process first batch - borrows and returns normally
  r1 <- processBatch pool (head reqs)
  
  -- Between batches, inject extra credits via the return path
  -- by calling returnCredits without a matching borrow
  -- This simulates the flash loan exploit: borrow, process, return MORE than borrowed
  let inflationAmount = 1000 :: Word32
  returnCredits pool 1 inflationAmount
  
  -- Now the ledger shows inflated balance after reconciliation
  r2 <- processBatch pool (reqs !! 1)
  
  -- Verify inflation occurred
  finalLedger <- readIORef (poolLedger pool)
  let conn1Balance = Map.findWithDefault 0 1 finalLedger
  -- conn1Balance is now higher than it should be
  
  return [r1, r2]

-- Validate that total credits in system are conserved
validateInvariant :: ConnectionPool -> Word32 -> IO Bool
validateInvariant pool expectedTotal = do
  ledger <- readIORef (poolLedger pool)
  let actualTotal = sum (Map.elems ledger)
  -- BUG: This validation reads from the ledger which is updated AFTER
  -- the potentially-inflated values are written in processBatch Phase 4
  -- It should independently sum the IORef values
  return (actualTotal <= expectedTotal * fromIntegral (poolSize pool))
